macros.title: Invoice location
macros.body: You can download invoices anytime from Billing > Invoices. Select a row and choose Download PDF.

macros.title: Invite teammate
macros.body: Go to Settings > Team > Invite member, enter their email, and choose a role (Admin, Member, or Viewer).

macros.title: Export workaround
macros.body: For large exports, try narrowing the date range or exporting by month. We are tracking a fix for jobs that stall near 50%.

macros.title: Webhook signing
macros.body: Verify webhooks using the signing secret in Developers > Webhooks. Compare the X-Signature header with an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body.

macros.title: Enterprise SLA reminder
macros.body: As an Enterprise customer you have 30-minute first response and 24/7 coverage for severity-1 issues. Reply URGENT in the subject to escalate.

macros.title: Closing — resolved
macros.body: Glad we could help. This ticket is marked resolved; reply within 7 days to reopen. We appreciate your feedback.
